text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-u-t o-f-f e-s-s-e-n-t-i-a-l u-t-i-l-i-t-i-e-s w-i-t-h-o-u-t a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-i-l-l-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g l-o-c-a-l h-o-u-s-i-n-g c-o-d-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d l-o-c-k h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e w-i-t-h-o-u-t l-e-g-a-l n-o-t-i-c-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-n-s-t-a-l-l-a-t-i-o-n i-n-v-o-i-c-e-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-o-u-r-t o-r-d-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-n-t t-h-r-e-a-t-e-n-i-n-g c-o-r-r-e-s-p-o-n-d-e-n-c-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-o-p-i-e-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g l-e-g-a-l a-d-v-i-s-o-r r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-d w-i-t-h a-b-a-p-a-r-t-m-e-n-t h-a-b-i-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n r-e-p-o-r-t-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g s-a-f-e-t-y i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-v-o-i-d-e-d h-o-u-s-i-n-g i-n-s-p-e-c-t-o-r a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g o-b-l-i-g-a-t-o-r-y n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e-s.
